title: Mission Team Settings
changes: Added company-scoped mission-team policy projection grounded in the existing temporary mission-team runtime and lifecycle states.
Preserved the canonical DRAFT/FORMING/ACTIVE/HANDOVER/COMPLETED/DISSOLVED/FAILED transition matrix as runtime-owned and immutable from Settings.
Added stricter optional activation gates for coordination owner, supervisor, coordinator and objective presence without creating or activating teams.
Preserved mandatory active-member and HANDOVER reference requirements, proposal-only membership/staffing behavior and authority-neutral team identities.
Rejected legacy tenant aliases and cross-company transition evaluation.
